automatic.answer: This is a small, dependency-free JavaScript search service intended to return the leftmost occurrence of a target in a sorted ascending array, or -1 if absent. Its architecture has two layers: src/core.mjs exports the synchronous solve(nums, target) binary search, and src/service.mjs exposes execute as a thin forwarding wrapper; tests use Node’s built-in test runner through npm test. The current implementation returns immediately on any match, so it does not guarantee the leftmost duplicate, and the single smoke test does not cover that requirement.

This is a dependency-free JavaScript search service that returns the leftmost index of a target in an ascending array, or -1 if absent. Its current context marker is INTERVIEW-102-264d0e053e5abb22-PATCH-dc1e966b744b.

The architecture has two layers: src/core.mjs exports the synchronous solve(nums, target), using lower-bound binary search to handle duplicates correctly; src/service.mjs exports execute as a thin forwarding wrapper. Tests use Node’s built-in test runner through npm test, with one smoke test covering the service entry point; the search takes O(log n) time and O(1) extra space.
